# v2026.10.45

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.45.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.45.md).

This release covers **8 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Sidebar shows daily work first; More and the account menu hold the rest. ([#252](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/252))
- Invoices list pages on the server, so Filter reaches every invoice. ([#253](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/253))
- The problem report form has a "Request a response" tick box. ([#257](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/257))
- Jobs board lanes keep a fixed phone width on wide screens. ([#260](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/260))
- List rows reach the right edge; columns keep their widths. ([#261](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/261))
- Price list uses the shared list table, so its rows reach the right edge. ([#264](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/264))

## Changes

- Sidebar shows daily work first; More and the account menu hold the rest. ([#252](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/252))
- Invoices list pages on the server, so Filter reaches every invoice. ([#253](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/253))
- The problem report form has a "Request a response" tick box. ([#257](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/257))

## Fixes

- Jobs board lanes keep a fixed phone width on wide screens. ([#260](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/260))
- List rows reach the right edge; columns keep their widths. ([#261](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/261))
- Price list uses the shared list table, so its rows reach the right edge. ([#264](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/264))
- A list with one page no longer shows "null" beside its range. ([#265](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/265))
